group_rules.pattern: ^(Online Advertisement for Travel|Travel Product Market Research)$

phase_rules.system_contains: Describe the image(s) below concisely and factually
You are given a short biography of an agent
Given a list of input episodic memories
generates specifications for realistic simulations of people
Given a list of input texts, this function combines them
Given a sampling description, computes the dimensions
This function defines which and how many people to sample
Generates a single full name for a person based on their complete sample characteristics

criteria.agent_action: Judge persona fidelity, realistic voice and emotions, response to latest stimuli, continuity, purposeful progression, grounded tool use and useful distinct contributions. Do not prescribe desired purchase decisions, scores, rankings or disagreement.
criteria.persona_generation: Check every supplied particularity, chronology, finances, feasibility, concrete motives, contradictions and unsupported external facts. Evaluate diversity across related outputs separately from individual plausibility; no claims of calibrated population sampling.
criteria.extraction: Compare every extracted field with the requested evidence scope and actual source history. Do not invent missing public reasons or substitute private thoughts for public answers when prohibited. Preserve labels, uncertainty and nonresponses.
criteria.persona_validation: Check question relevance, expectation fidelity, justified score, phase progression and evidence boundaries. Model evaluator confidence is not ground truth or psychometric validity.
criteria.proposition_scoring: Check the proposition against its supplied context, score scale and explicit supporting or contradicting evidence. Do not equate fluent explanations or high self-confidence with correctness.
criteria.memory_consolidation: Check preservation of important facts, uncertainty, temporal order and who said or did what. Compression must not invent facts or turn unresolved proposals into completed actions.
criteria.text_consolidation: Check fidelity to every input, consistency, attribution, deduplication and absence of invented details. Important disagreements and uncertainty must survive.
criteria.persona_summary: Compare summary against the full specification; preserve discriminative traits without adding unsupported biography or uniformly idealizing people.
criteria.story_continuation: Check temporal and scene continuity, role boundaries, actual actions, evidence availability and whether narration creates useful progression rather than repeated promises. Do not imply executed actions from suggestions.
criteria.content_enrichment: Check fidelity to the source, explicit content and length requirements, useful detail and unsupported additions. Elaborate style must not manufacture measured results, credentials or completed events.
criteria.sampling_dimensions: Check requested population, explicit axes, allowable values and scientific plausibility. A rich dimension inventory alone does not demonstrate dimensions were used downstream.
criteria.sampling_plan: Check sample counts, allowed traits, combinations, requested axes, internal consistency and exclusions. Later empirical agreement is a separate population-level question.
criteria.name_generation_unique: Check explicit naming constraints, uniqueness against the supplied list and output structure; do not infer protected demographic facts solely from a name.
criteria.name_generation_conditioned: Check supplied naming constraints and syntactic output. Plausibility of a name is not proof of a person's ethnicity, nationality or representative sampling.
criteria.vision_perception: Judge observable image grounding and uncertainty using the actual supplied images. Do not infer medical diagnostic accuracy from filenames or descriptions.
criteria.normalization: Compare clusters and canonical labels against all source elements. Avoid false equivalence, loss of distinctions, dropped inputs or invented categories.

default_criterion: Unclassified prompt: inspect the full request, its output contract and source evidence before assigning a semantic quality label.
limitations: Retained caches include earlier attempts, diagnostic replays and final runs. A case is not asserted to belong to the final promoted notebook execution.

All recovered observations are Luna outputs conditioned on their actual cached histories. No exact GPT-5-mini input/output pairs are fabricated, and earlier Luna-generated histories may bias fixed-context comparisons.
Each distinct response ID is kept once; every source occurrence and source-file hash is recorded. Different completions of the same normalized request remain separate observations.

Schema classes are reconstructed from current matching library definitions and SDK strict conversion, not captured wire payloads. Complete original cache keys and unchanged message content remain preserved.

Scenario families and sources connected by identical requests or copied responses stay in one split. Existing 20-case diagnostic sources are pinned to optimization. The declared fraction sets the ceiling-rounded number of validation groups among all connected groups; eligible groups are chosen by seeded hash rank. The split is not persona-identity-disjoint or prompt-template-disjoint.

Validation scenarios were previously executed and some outputs reviewed during notebook auditing. This is reserved-from-further-optimization validation data, not a historically unseen or blinded test.
Optimization and validation subsets are balanced diagnostic selections, not representative population samples. The complete corpus remains available for cohort-level analysis.
New outputs are explicitly unreviewed. Notebook acceptance/rejection and structural validity are not individual semantic quality labels or gold answers.
Cached successes do not provide a complete ledger of failed API attempts, retries or costs. Extraction itself makes no model calls.

Preserved image inputs are required for vision evaluation. Content may include synthetic personal details, private simulated thoughts, document extracts and base64 images; keep the bundle local unless disclosure rights are established.
Whole-corpus replay can be costly and overrepresent repeated utility calls. Begin with the bounded subsets and keep validation separate from prompt tuning.
